SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))::DATE AS month_start,
  ABS(SUM(COALESCE(op.payment_value, 0))) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))::DATE
ORDER BY month_start;
